items.readable_text:
Content:
Recall that the mode of a data set is the value that occurs most often in a data set. In this lesson, we'll learn how to determine the mode of a data set presented as a frequency table.

Content:
Consider a data set with the corresponding frequency table shown below. What is the mode of this data set?

Content:
| Value | Frequency |
| [MATH: 5] | [MATH: 2] |
| [MATH: 8] | [MATH: 7] |
| [MATH: 12] | [MATH: 3] |
| [MATH: 16] | [MATH: 4] |

Content:
From the table, we see that the highest frequency is [MATH: 7,] corresponding to the value [MATH: 8.]

Content:
| Value | Frequency |
| [MATH: 5] | [MATH: 2] |
| [MATH: \color{blue}8] | [MATH: \color{blue}7] |
| [MATH: 12] | [MATH: 3] |
| [MATH: 16] | [MATH: 4] |

Content:
Therefore, the mode of the data set is [MATH: 8.]

Content:

  • We cannot have [MATH: x=6] since [MATH: 6 > 7] is false. [MATH: \color{red}{\times}]

Therefore, the correct answer is option II.
